name: Aircraft Studio
tagline: Design an aircraft on your phone with AI, turn it into 3D, then fly it in an AR mission with a leaderboard.

awards: Windsurf: Best Project built with Windsurf

problem: 3D design tools are desktop-first and heavy.
solution: Text prompts generate concept images, converted to lightweight 3D models, then flown in a browser AR game.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a plane, preview it in 3D, and fly it in AR.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Windsurf: Best Project built with Windsurf” among 261 submissions.

lessons: Phone-based AR lets every judge try the demo.
